Focus component: model_design. Use Tier 2 architectural deepening by replacing each block’s second linear causal convolution with a gated causal convolution. The latest model reached validation HR@10 of 0.645, below the recorded best of 0.665, so adding a local shortcut has not demonstrated an improvement. A plausible remaining limitation is that irrelevant historical features can propagate through the second convolution without content-dependent filtering.

Change conv2 to produce twice the hidden width, split its output into value and gate channels, and combine them using tanh(value) multiplied by sigmoid(gate). Preserve its existing dilation and left-only padding so every representation remains strictly causal. This gate controls which temporal features enter the residual update, complementing the existing gate that mixes local and dilated receptive fields. Initialize the new gate-channel biases to +1 so feature transmission starts mostly open, while preserving the residual scales, normalization, dropout, short convolution, embeddings, and scoring interfaces.

Keep all eight constants and every frozen host component unchanged to isolate this single architectural experiment. Evaluate one candidate through the host and retain it only if validation HR@10 exceeds 0.665; the proposed benefit is a hypothesis, not an established gain.
